Target of railway lines

Source: R/rail-line-get.R
rail_line_target.Rd

rail_line_target() and rail_line_target_raw() declare a target of a 'targets' pipeline whose value is rail_line_get(year). The target is rerun when year, the URL of the file of that year, or the installed version of locationchoicedatajp change.

Usage

rail_line_target(name, year, ...)

rail_line_target_raw(name, year, ...)

Arguments

name

Name of the target: a symbol for rail_line_target(), a string for rail_line_target_raw().

year

Reference year: 2006 to 2008, and 2011 to the latest release. Releases are as of December 31 of their year. See rail_line_files() for the available years.

...

Other arguments passed to targets::tar_target_raw().

Value

A target object.

Examples

rail_line_target(lines_2020, 2020)
#> <tar_stem> 
#>   name: lines_2020 
#>   description:  
#>   command:
#>     locationchoicedatajp::rail_line_get(year = 2020)
#>     https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/data/N02/N02-20/N02-20_GML.zip
#>     0.0.0.9000 
#>   format: rds 
#>   repository: local 
#>   iteration method: vector 
#>   error mode: stop 
#>   memory mode: auto 
#>   storage mode: worker 
#>   retrieval mode: auto 
#>   deployment mode: worker 
#>   priority: 0 
#>   resources:
#>     list() 
#>   cue:
#>     seed: TRUE
#>     file: TRUE
#>     iteration: TRUE
#>     repository: TRUE
#>     format: TRUE
#>     depend: TRUE
